scope: Align project facts beside their actions
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

welcome-desktop-dark.png.task: Compare projects and their open conversations in compact aligned rows.
welcome-desktop-dark.png.observations: Conversation and waiting counts now form compact labeled components beside project entry actions. The Website row correctly reads '1 Conversation'. Project paths remain readable/selectable, title and counts align, and waiting color accompanies its label. Compact first project and actions fit without overlap; further projects remain in the scrolling list. Both appearances retain contrast.
